# ClawbackShield

> Plain-English help for U.S. Social Security and SSI overpayment ("clawback") notices. Paste or upload a notice to get a free summary of the amount, deadlines and options, then build an SSA-632-BK waiver case, a pause-withholding letter and a post-filing tracker. Not a law firm, not legal advice, not affiliated with SSA.

Key facts (with official sources):
- Waiver: SSA must waive recovery if you were not at fault and repaying would defeat the purpose of benefits or be against equity and good conscience (20 CFR 404.506; 20 CFR 416.550). You can ask any time.
- Phone waiver: original overpayments of $2,000 or less can often be waived by phone at 1-800-772-1213 if SSA can presume no fault (SSA POMS GN 02250.350).
- Withholding: default is 50% of the monthly Social Security benefit for notices sent on or after April 25, 2025; 10% for SSI. Filing a waiver or appeal within 30 days generally delays withholding until SSA decides.
- Forms: SSA-632-BK (waiver), SSA-561 (reconsideration, 60-day deadline), SSA-634 (lower recovery rate).
